# ELITK-8
> Enterprise AI orchestration platform and web application.

## Project & Creator
- Author: Mohamed Osama ([Portfolio](https://mohamedosama.me))
- Studio: [BagbackTech](https://bagbacktech.com)
- Handle: mohamedosamaai
- Repo: https://github.com/mohamedosamaai/elitk-8
- License: MIT

## Architecture
- Pattern: Full-stack TypeScript monorepo
- Frontend: React 18 + Vite + Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Express 5 + Drizzle ORM
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions + CodeQL

## Key Engineering Concepts Demonstrated
- Type-safe API contracts with Zod
- Real-time streaming with SSE
- Docker multi-stage builds
- Automated security scanning

## Documentation
- Wiki: https://github.com/mohamedosamaai/elitk-8/wiki
- Quickstart: See README.md
- API Reference: See docs/API.md

## Files
- README.md: Project overview and quickstart
- server.ts: Express API entry point
- src/: React frontend application
- .github/workflows/: CI/CD pipelines
